skill.name: tavily-search-free
skill.description: Run Tavily web searches for current, LLM-ready research results using a configured API key.
skill.summary: Search the web with Tavily and return concise results for research and RAG workflows.
skill.author: Dwsy

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation false positives, including Markdown backticks, placeholder URLs, example commands, and hidden-path references. Confirmed risks are the runtime handling of TAVILY_API_KEY and external Tavily searches. No prompt injection attempt, obfuscated payload, or evidence of secret exfiltration beyond intended Tavily SDK use was found.

remediation.issue: Credential handling is required for Tavily authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Remove claims that API keys are preconfigured. Tell users to provide their own TAVILY_API_KEY outside distributed skill files and never commit dotenv files.

remediation.issue: Search queries are sent to an external Tavily service.
remediation.suggestion: Document that user queries and authentication are sent through the Tavily SDK. Advise users not to submit confidential or regulated data.

remediation.issue: Dependency installation is documented without version constraints.
remediation.suggestion: Pin or recommend verified versions for tavily-python and python-dotenv, preferably inside an isolated virtual environment.

remediation.issue: Documentation uses hidden home-directory paths and contains sample path typos.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer relative paths in examples where possible and correct the skily/skilly path typos to reduce unsafe copy-paste behavior.

content.value_statement: Fresh web information can be hard to collect and format for LLM work. This skill runs Tavily searches and returns concise results for research and RAG workflows.
actual_capabilities: Runs Tavily web searches from a Python command-line script.
Accepts a required search query argument.
Supports basic and advanced Tavily search depth modes.
Lets users choose the maximum number of returned results.
Loads the Tavily API key from environment variables or a dotenv file.
Prints search results in a structured format for downstream LLM use.
limitations: Requires a valid Tavily API key before searches can run.
Sends search queries to Tavily, so sensitive queries need care.
Depends on Tavily service limits, availability, and result quality.
Does not verify source accuracy beyond Tavily result ranking.

use_cases.title: Research current topics
use_cases.description: Gather recent web sources and short summaries for fast topic orientation.

use_cases.title: Prepare RAG source discovery
use_cases.description: Find candidate pages for retrieval pipelines before deeper ingestion or review.

use_cases.title: Investigate technical questions
use_cases.description: Search current documentation, comparisons, and troubleshooting notes while coding.

prompt_templates.title: Search a topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily to search for recent information about [topic] and summarize the top results.

prompt_templates.title: Compare source perspectives
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Tavily for [topic] and compare the strongest points from five relevant sources.

prompt_templates.title: Plan RAG ingestion
prompt_templates.prompt: Run an advanced Tavily search for [domain question]. Return source titles, links, and concise content notes for ingestion planning.

prompt_templates.title: Review time-sensitive evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily advanced search to gather current evidence about [claim]. Separate confirmed facts, unresolved points, and source caveats.

output_examples.input: Search for current AI safety regulation updates.
output_examples.output: A concise list of relevant pages with titles, source links, short summaries, and relevance notes.

output_examples.input: Compare recent guidance on Python async error handling.
output_examples.output: A ranked source summary that highlights common recommendations and differences between current references.

output_examples.input: Find sources for a RAG dataset about electric vehicle charging standards.
output_examples.output: Candidate source pages with brief content descriptions and notes about usefulness for retrieval ingestion.

best_practices: Use specific search terms and include dates when freshness matters.
Store TAVILY_API_KEY outside committed files and rotate it if exposed.
Review returned sources before using them in reports or datasets.
anti_patterns: Do not search for private credentials, customer data, or confidential project details.
Do not treat search snippets as verified facts without source review.
Do not commit dotenv files or hardcoded API keys with this skill.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It runs Tavily web searches and returns concise results for LLM research workflows.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs TAVILY_API_KEY in the environment or a local dotenv file.

faq.question: Can it search current web content?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses Tavily for current web search, subject to Tavily availability and limits.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The skill metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Are search queries private?
faq.answer: No. Queries are sent to Tavily, so avoid sensitive or confidential searches.

faq.question: Does it verify source accuracy?
faq.answer: No. It returns search results and summaries, but users must verify important claims.
